persistenceContract.rewardTransaction: Record inventory transfer and anchor claim atomically; partial receipt preserves remaining contents; no loot regeneration on load, destruction, boss reset or template update. Detached container keeps same inventory ID.
persistenceContract.destruction: Collision, cover, water and component function derive from current voxels. Door flags cannot keep a destroyed opening blocked. Player assembled pieces are machine; naturally detached world pieces object.
persistenceContract.revisit: Never rebuild template over saved deltas. Offline growth is bounded by surviving populations, inputs and capacity; no time-only enemy refill.
persistenceContract.deathRecovery: Keep death inventory in separate persistent ledger; within 10m of death point fairy recovery must not require original room route, boss victory, visible body or intact floor. Full inventory leaves remainder stored.
persistenceContract.migration: Template version pinned per instance; new generator applies to unvisited instances only until explicit migration exists.

acceptanceChecks: Validate every reference and all positions at 0.5m cell grid.
Rasterize shells and corridors; flood-fill a 0.8m-wide 1.8m-high person from both entrances to every reward anchor.
Sweep 5m-wide 4.5m-high machine envelope along main entrance/workshop/antechamber/arena route, including bends and exterior bypass; side corridors intentionally allow smaller machines only.
Verify boss room permanent escape strip and two exterior escape paths remain after all encounter phases; no combat locks.
Disable puzzle route and confirm an alternate route through the template-specific graph or exterior bypass; breach arbitrary wall and verify identical loot ledger and correct population boundaries.
Save/reload after container detached, partial loot, flooded corridor, broken producer, displaced moving platform and death; no duplication/reset.
Boss adds share species population cap; clear occupied or reserved slots before spawning.
Check room/corridor geometry collision and occlusion in actual voxel engine; design data validation alone does not establish runtime navigation.
